title: 4X Strategy with Ground/Space Battles, Colony Management, Spying, Diplomacy, and onboard LLM opponent Brain
author: MrLawliet
selftext:
I've been working on **Broken Rift: Dominion** for quite a while using AI, and recently released it on Google Play and Steam demo.

Growing up, my favorite games were **Imperium Galactica 1 & 2**. I loved how they combined colony management, space and ground battles, research, espionage, and diplomacy into one coherent game. You could conquer the galaxy militarily, sabotage enemy fleets with intelligence agents, or build a diplomatic power bloc.

I haven't found anything quite like them since, so after a couple of decades as a developer, I figured AI had finally gotten good enough to help me build the game I'd always wanted.

For replayability, I included an **onboard Qwen 2.5 3B model** that runs entirely offline. It helps control rival factions with their own personalities, doctrines, and objectives. They can negotiate, threaten, insult, and react to whether their plans actually succeed or fail.

The game includes a **full campaign and customizable skirmish mode**, and I've used Google Play's translation service to support 29 languages, including having Qwen respond in the selected language.

**Google Play (1-hour free trial):**  
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lastexitdiner.brokenriftdominion](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lastexitdiner.brokenriftdominion)

**Steam (free demo):**  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5122860/Broken\_Rift\_Dominion/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5122860/Broken_Rift_Dominion/)

Would love to hear what other AI game developers think. Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are all welcome!
